title: Australian Bush Herb Stew
description: A hearty stew made with bush herbs and australian bush ingredients, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the beef broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the chopped bush tomato and fermented bush herbs, stir for 1-2 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Add the chopped potatoes and green beans, and continue to simmer for another 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: serve with crusty bread or a side salad.
